sn46.7:1.1: “Bhikkhus, just as all the rafters of a peaked house slant, slope, and incline towards the roof peak,
sn46.7:1.2: so too, when a bhikkhu develops and cultivates the seven factors of enlightenment, he slants, slopes, and inclines towards Nibbāna.
sn46.7:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness,
sn46.7:2.3: which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release…. He develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn46.7:2.4: It is in this way that a bhikkhu develops and cultivates the seven factors of enlightenment so that he slants, slopes, and inclines towards Nibbāna.”
